title: Falcon Space Biefeld-Brown vacuum test: rotation reverses as pressure drops
summary: David tells of Falcon Space Biefeld-Brown vacuum test: rotation reverses as pressure drops, about an unknown time at Falcon Space vacuum chamber, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: A researcher named David, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, describes a vacuum chamber test by a group called Falcon Space of the Biefeld-Brown effect, a claimed push produced by high-voltage electrical devices that some link to antigravity. He says that at moderate pressure the device spun in one direction, and as they kept pumping the air out it eventually started spinning the other way. That would matter because a reversal with almost no air suggests the force is not just air being pushed around.
